explanation: Raw reset gate r7 tracks an a2/S2-favouring signal on top of a strong timing ramp (rises through the episode; GO lowest, D2 highest). Observed-only drivers: (1) the ideal-observer belief that S2 is good (negative belief_lo raises it, in every phase, strongest at D2). (2) Previous-trial pattern, phase-specific: at D1 it is raised after a2 trials that were rewarded (a2 S1 r most, a2 S2 r) and lowered after unrewarded a1 trials (a1 S2 u, a1 S1 u) and a2 S2 u; at GO/D2 it is raised after a2 S1 u (model-based stay on a2) and lowered after a1 S1 r and a1 S2 u (model-based stay on a1 / switch evidence), i.e. a model-based a2 tendency. (3) At D2, the choice just made: higher after a2, lower if S2 was reached (a2 S1 rare highest, a1 S2 lowest). Current reward and hidden good state add nothing beyond these. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.74 (dev 0.75), vs observed-only ceiling 0.82 and all-cue ceiling 0.91; the earlier model-policy explanation (policy decile alone 0.74) is matched by observed quantities, so little is lost. Residual misses: some episodes sit uniformly high during long a1 S1 r runs (under-predicted by about 0.25).

issues: Small overclaim: the explanation says the previous-trial pattern raises the gate after a2 S1 u at D2 as well as GO. The fitted D2 history term has a tiny weight (+0.028), and dropping it changes test R^2 beyond timing only from 0.7416 to 0.7404. Once belief and the D2 choice/state are in, the D2 history effect is absorbed. It is really a GO-only effect.
The D1 belief effect is weak (weight -0.009 per log-odds unit, against -0.034 at D2). Removing it costs about 0.008 (test 0.734), so 'in every phase' holds, but only barely at D1.

The label's 'lowered by unrewarded a1' leaves out that at GO the largest negative history cell is a1 S1 r (rewarded a1, residual -0.14). The lowering is better described as 'a1-favouring history' than 'unrewarded a1'.

The remaining systematic error is real and is the one the explanation names. Most of the worst-fit dev windows are long a1 S1 r runs where the gate sits uniformly about 0.2-0.27 above the prediction at D1 and D2 (and about 0.1 at GO), across the whole window. No observed-only term I tried fixed it, so it looks like a per-episode offset in the agent's internal state: belief_cover (0.7404), belief_lo*belief_cover (0.7410), clipped belief_lo (0.7428), |belief_lo| (0.7406), start_high (0.7405), a 2-back a1 S1 r streak (0.7449), an a2 count over 3 back trials (0.7408). Systematic errors by phase x previous trial are all within ±0.07; the largest are D2 after a1 S2 u (-0.064) and D2 after a2 S1 r (+0.062).

The other claims check out on test: belief alone plus the D2 choice/state reaches 0.594, and the full set reaches 0.7416. The D2 a2 effect is positive (+0.117) and the S2-reached effect negative (-0.102). The residual tables support the D1 pattern (a2 S1 r +0.20, a2 S2 r +0.12, a1 S2 u -0.24, a1 S1 u -0.18, a2 S2 u -0.13) and the GO pattern (a2 S1 u +0.24, a1 S1 r -0.14, a1 S2 u -0.11). No future variables are used. The fit is 0.74 against an observed-only ceiling of 0.82 and matches the 0.74 policy-decile reference.
